title: Content translations
subtitle: Courses, modules, lessons, categories, lives, plans: every visitor sees the content in their own language. Original texts are never modified.
auto_confirm: Automatically translate missing or outdated items into {{lang}}? Hand-made translations are not touched.
auto_hint: Uses the {{model}} model. You can review and correct every translation below.
auto_not_configured: Automatic translation is not configured. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the API's .env to translate new content automatically. Meanwhile, you can translate by hand below.
how_it_works: A translation is “outdated” when the original text has changed since: the visitor then sees the original until you update it. Administrators and instructors always see the original texts.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
